description: This header file declares the external API for the Dslh Wmp Database object, including functions for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization, meant for use within the DSL Home Model Implementation system.

methods.name: DslhCreateWmpDatabase
methods.description: Creates a Wmp Database object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: DslhWmpdoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Wmp Database object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: DslhWmpdoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects into the Wmp Database instance.
